title: The Foreman runs its own watcher and wakes at worst every 55 minutes
summary: Specified: Claude Code steering wake 55m by default (Suspect follows), a Foreman watcher (watch --stream) on its batch's merge, red-CI and wait-met lines, kept on a pause; the Foreman records merges, the Chief of Staff only while that watcher is not running. After watcher-limit, CR-471.
